entries.notes: All 10 benchmark scenario declarations are translated. The Rust contract preserves the in-deployment preflight and clientStart clock anchor, exact workflow names and arguments, sequential sampling, bounded retry budgets, three-attempt zero-success abort, exact step/chunk count validation, TTFS targets, CRTT index buckets, size and progress profiles, replay cadence identity, fan-out first/last completion metrics, destination-kind STSO splitting, and whole-run overhead. WF-RUST-090 records that security and measurement-integrity cases require malformed trigger responses and mismatched return counts to fail closed, prevent a remote target from consuming an unbounded retry budget, and retain semantic cadence hashes so a changed workload cannot inherit an unrelated baseline. Final GREEN must drive the real Rust runtime and workbench route; fabricated observations or local-only timestamps are insufficient.
